global_prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> is the REAPER and the place: an ethereal dark figure in flowing tattered robes carrying a skull-scythe, standing in an arid desert. His silhouette, his robes, his scythe and that desert are taken from it and from nothing else.
<Picture 2> is a multi-view character sheet and it is the appearance lock for the WARRIOR: a muscular tribal warrior in a mask, a red cape and a yellow tattered bone-adorned skirt, with dreadlocks, a scarred body and bare feet. Every view on that sheet is the same man, so his mask, cape, skirt, hair, scars and build must match it from every angle and never be redesigned.
There are exactly two figures in the fight and no one else. The desert is empty.

style:
Hyper-kinetic desert combat spectacle, extreme high-intensity CGI action, thick volumetric cinematic haze and golden-hour dust storms, aggressive anamorphic 35mm lens with heavy motion blur, relentless handheld tracking and whip pans, deep shadows, heat distortion and ultra-realistic particle systems. Photorealistic, ultra-detailed fabric physics and particle simulation, perfect motion blur, volumetric haze at maximum density, coherent anatomy and proportions, cinematic colour grade and movie-level VFX polish.

continuity:
Relentless. The fight never pauses, never resets and never restages: each shot picks the two figures up exactly where the previous one left them, with the same footing, the same damage and the same dust in the air. The warrior's cape and the reaper's robes accumulate damage and never repair themselves. If a reference frame is given, it is the exact frame this shot starts on -- begin on it and carry the motion forward.

sound:
Bone-heavy impacts, cloth snapping, sand and grit, the scythe cutting air, the reaper's dry spectral rasp and the warrior's breathing and grunts of effort. No speech and no dialogue from either figure.

prompts.text:
integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] 00:00–00:05
EXTREME WIDE CRASH-IN.
Instant violent collision, no build-up. The warrior explodes forward through a dense dust cloud, red cape whipping behind him. The reaper swings the massive scythe in a wide horizontal arc to meet him. The impact detonates a shockwave of sand and embers outward across the ground. The camera crashes in with them.

overall_soundscape:
A single enormous impact, a shockwave of sand, embers crackling, cloth snapping and the scythe tearing the air.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] 00:00–00:05
DYNAMIC LOW TRACKING.
A rapid exchange, the camera low and tracking hard. The warrior ducks under the scythe, drives a spinning elbow into the reaper's ribs and follows it with an upward knee. The reaper partially phases, reforms mid-strike and counters with a spectral claw rake across the warrior's chest. Fabric and ash particles explode outward.

overall_soundscape:
Two heavy body impacts, a low spectral rasp as the reaper phases and reforms, the tearing of fabric and grit underfoot.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] 00:00–00:05
ORBITING MEDIUM, DUTCH ANGLE.
An acrobatic mid-air clash, the camera orbiting on a hard Dutch angle. The warrior vaults off the scythe shaft with the red cape fully extended and lands a dual-fist hammer blow onto the reaper's hood. The reaper retaliates with a vertical scythe slam that cracks the ground open; the warrior rolls clear and rises into a spinning back-kick that shreds more of the robe into black ribbons.

overall_soundscape:
A vault off the scythe shaft, a double hammer impact, the ground cracking under the slam, and torn cloth flapping.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] 00:00–00:05
HANDHELD CLOSE COMBAT FRENZY.
A brutal ground scramble, the camera handheld and right on top of them. The warrior grapples the scythe pole, headbutts the mask, rips free and unleashes three distinct strikes: an upward palm, a horizontal elbow and a downward axe-kick. The reaper absorbs them, then unleashes a tendril-whip of shadow that lashes across the warrior's back, drawing blood and dust.

overall_soundscape:
Wood and bone grinding together, a headbutt, three sharp separate impacts, then the crack of a shadow whip and a sharp intake of breath.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] 00:00–00:05
SLOW-MOTION IMPACT MONTAGE.
Escalating power, the speed dropping into slow motion on each impact. The warrior catches the scythe mid-swing, twists it aside and drives his knee into the reaper's midsection twice, then lands a spinning heel kick that sends the figure airborne. The reaper crashes down in an explosion of ash and sand, robes half dissolved. The warrior advances without mercy.

overall_soundscape:
Impacts stretched long and low, air displaced by the kick, and a heavy collapse into sand and ash.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] 00:00–00:05
WIDE TO TIGHT PUSH-IN.
The finishing sequence, the camera pushing from wide into tight. The warrior seizes the collapsing reaper by the remaining hood, delivers a savage rising uppercut and follows it with a final two-handed overhead smash. The reaper's entire form shatters into swirling black ash and ember particles that scatter across the desert floor. The warrior stands over the dissipating cloud, breathing hard.

overall_soundscape:
A rising uppercut, a final crushing double-handed impact, a dry shattering dispersal of ash, then wind and hard breathing.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] 00:00–00:05
HARD CUT -- REVERSE EXTREME CLOSE-UP.
A HARD CUT to the reverse angle, an extreme close-up. The blurred warrior fills the foreground, chest heaving, sweat and dust streaking his mask, his mouth open in ragged breath. Behind him the background is sharp and deep: the dark figure slowly reconstitutes itself from the residual ash, the scythe reforming in its hand, rising and stalking forward with predatory stillness.

overall_soundscape:
Close ragged breathing over wind, then a low dry rasp gathering behind him as the figure reforms.
